<!-- pr-reviewer: e6c1c121686c8adf758a5dd0638a4c2310ab69b1 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

### What looks good
- The net diff of `assets/posts/sinumerik.cps` against `origin/main` adds 7 comment lines only (around line 725). The refusal from the first commit (c9198785b) is fully removed. The `P` condition `ms > 0 && g !== "G73" && g !== "G84"` is the same as on main, so the posted output does not change.
- G73 does not change. #2354 stays open.
- `crates/post/tests/sinumerik_g83_dwell.rs` pins the three cases: G83 with `P500` before F, G83 with no dwell and no P, and G82 with `P500`. The file has a provenance line and a Gate map that names `camcraft_post`. It is in the lowest crate that provides its imports.
- `docs/decisions/2349-sinumerik-g83-dwell.md` quotes the maintainer and names the Siemens "ISO dialects" Function Manual 07/2021. It gives the manual content in its own words (which cycle lists which word), with no copied manual text. It records the dropped options and the disagreement on G73.
- No golden changed. No snapshot PNG changed. No process file changed.
- The PR body has `Changelog: none`, the readings, the pinning tests and "Not exercised". It ends with `Fixes #2349`. No closing keyword is before #2354, #2356 or #2357.
- The CR-byte check of the diff is clean (0 CR bytes).

### Results merged with main (locally)
Trial merge with `origin/main` was clean. After the merge, the diff against `origin/main` is the 3 PR files only.

| Binary (`camcraft-post`) | Result |
|---|---|
| `sinumerik_g83_dwell` | 3 passed |
| `script_sinumerik` | 11 passed |
| `bore_cycle` | 7 passed |
| `cycle_hop` | 7 passed |
| `ream_cycle` | 5 passed |
| `probe_dialects` | 13 passed |
| `setup_change` | 28 passed |
| `work_offset_index` | 9 passed |
| `first_traverse_clearance_fanuc_family` | 9 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

Not built: the other `camcraft-post` binaries and the `camcraft-app` conformance goldens. The post output does not change, so they are not touched.

### Requested before merge
None.

### Notes (not blocking)
1. The new comment in `assets/posts/sinumerik.cps` (about line 725) says that the dwell is P "on G82 and G83". The condition also writes P on G85 (REAM) and G89 (BACKBORE) when the dwell is more than 0. This is the behaviour of main and not of this PR. Table 6-2, as the decision file reports it, lists no P on G85. A follow-up issue (P7, or P3 if a G85 dwell can reach the post) can make the comment complete and check the G85 case.
2. The maintainer chose "Post P as on G83" for G73 in the dialog. This PR keeps G73 as on main and leaves #2354 open for his decision. That is correct for the scope of #2349.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

No actionable comments were generated in the recent review.

# Transforming Code Reviews with AI

## Features

**Automated Reviews**: Continuous reviews of the pull requests including incremental commits. 

**Summarization**: Generates high-level summary and a technical walkthrough of the PR changes. 

**Line-by-line review**: Provides line-by-line suggestions committable with one click.

**Codebase verification**:  Verifies the impact on the overall codebase and identifies missing changes.

**Insights into your code**:  Ask any questions on your codebase within the pull request 

**Chat about your code** : Chat with the bot around your code. The more you chat, the smarter it gets.

**Issue Validation**:  Validates the PR against the linked issues and identifies other related issues
